description: NIST Special Publication 800-53 Rev 5 security controls mapped to Legion telemetry

architecture_lanes.name: Linux Kernel, LKM, and Audit View
npm, pip, and AI SDK Supply Chain View

escalation_policy: Critical rootkit, bootkit, credential scraping, package worm, or listener tamper evidence requires host isolation and volatile evidence preservation.
High confidence package-manager lifecycle execution requires dependency freeze, lockfile review, and credential rotation assessment.
Any traversal write outside node_modules/site-packages/build directories requires artifact hash capture and package provenance review.

rules.title: Least Privilege
rules.description: Principle of least privilege violated: privilege escalation alert active.
rules.remediation: Enforce minimum necessary access rights. Audit elevated process list. Remove unnecessary admin grants.

rules.title: Event Logging
rules.description: Critical Windows security events detected in the audit log.
rules.remediation: Investigate all critical-level Windows events. Ensure centralized log collection. Review audit policy scope.

rules.title: Least Functionality
rules.description: New unauthorized processes detected in baseline drift — system may be running unnecessary services.
rules.remediation: Identify and terminate unauthorized processes. Disable unnecessary services. Apply application allowlisting.

rules.title: Incident Handling
rules.description: Active CVE-match alerts require formal incident response procedures.
rules.remediation: Activate incident response plan. Document findings. Patch or isolate affected components. Notify stakeholders.

rules.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
rules.description: OSV vulnerability findings exist in scanned package inventory.
rules.remediation: Schedule regular OSV/CISA KEV scanning. Remediate findings within SLA. Track open vulnerabilities.

rules.title: Malicious Code Protection
rules.description: YARA signature matches detected — potential malware or malicious code artifacts present.
rules.remediation: Quarantine YARA-matched files. Run full system scan. Update AV/EDR signatures. Investigate lateral movement.

rules.title: System Monitoring
rules.description: New remote IP connections detected outside the established baseline.
rules.remediation: Investigate new remote connections. Verify legitimacy. Block unauthorized external endpoints. Review firewall rules.

rules.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
rules.description: Typosquatted packages detected — software integrity may be compromised.
rules.remediation: Remove typosquatted packages immediately. Audit package registry usage. Implement package integrity verification.

rules.title: System Monitoring - Rootkit Stealth
rules.description: Local monitoring detected rootkit, syscall hook, hidden artifact, or LD_PRELOAD stealth indicators.
hunt_steps: Compare process, file, driver, and network views against a trusted source
Inspect kernel/userland hook evidence
Preserve volatile state before remediation
rules.remediation: Preserve evidence, isolate the host, compare process/network/file views from trusted media, and verify kernel/userland hook integrity.

rules.title: Integrity - Kernel Module or Extension Abuse
rules.description: Local monitoring detected Linux kernel module load/unload behavior associated with kernel persistence.
hunt_steps: Validate module signer, hash, path, and parent process
Review load time against package/install activity
Check persistence and security policy state
rules.remediation: Validate module signer, path, hash, and parent process. Review /lib/modules.

rules.title: Audit Information Protection - Listener Tamper
rules.description: Local monitoring detected audit, journal, EDR, or alert listener tampering that can suppress security evidence.
rules.check_value: audit log cleared|journal file|corrupt|tamper|sensor stopped|edr stopped|defender disabled|security tool disabled
hunt_steps: Compare event continuity across independent sources
Review privileged actions around telemetry loss
Preserve logs before service restart
rules.remediation: Confirm telemetry integrity against independent sources, preserve logs before restart, and review privileged activity around the tamper window.

rules.title: Malicious Code Protection - npm/pip Worm Intelligence
rules.description: AI threat intelligence indicates npm or pip package behavior consistent with worm-style propagation, dependency impersonation, credential theft, or install-time execution.
hunt_steps: Identify package name, ecosystem, version, and maintainer provenance
Diff package tarball/wheel contents against trusted release
Search for lifecycle scripts and credential access
Freeze dependency updates and rotate exposed API keys
rules.remediation: Quarantine the package, freeze lockfiles, remove malicious dependencies, rotate potentially exposed npm/PyPI/Git/API tokens, and review transitive dependents for propagation.

rules.title: System Monitoring - Package Manager Lifecycle Execution
rules.description: Local telemetry contains npm or pip lifecycle execution patterns commonly used by worm-style packages for traversal, download, execution, or credential discovery.
rules.check_value: npm postinstall|npm preinstall|prepare script|node-gyp rebuild|pip install|setup.py install|pyproject.toml|python -m pip|curl |wget |powershell -enc|process.env|site-packages|node_modules
hunt_steps: Map lifecycle process tree and parent package
Review network egress during install
Check for credential/environment reads
Hash dropped artifacts
rules.remediation: Block the lifecycle script source, rebuild the environment from trusted lockfiles, revoke exposed credentials, and add package-manager execution monitoring.

rules.title: System Monitoring - Package Traversal Write Heuristic
rules.description: Local telemetry indicates path traversal or archive-slip style writes from package installation or build activity.
rules.check_value: path traversal|directory traversal|zip slip|tar slip|write outside|../|..\|../../|..\..\|node_modules/../|site-packages/../|package extracted outside|archive traversal
hunt_steps: Identify destination path outside expected install root
Trace archive/package source
Review dropped executable and credential file access
Rebuild from trusted artifacts
rules.remediation: Remove the affected package tree, restore overwritten files from trusted media, rotate credentials if secrets were reachable, and enforce archive/path normalization controls.

rules.title: Integrity - Dependency Worm Propagation Heuristic
rules.description: Baseline drift indicates new packages or package graph changes that may represent worm-style dependency propagation across npm, pip, containers, or CI runners.
hunt_steps: Compare package graph to last trusted baseline
Review whether new dependencies were direct, transitive, or install-script generated
Validate registry source and hashes
rules.remediation: Pin and verify dependency versions, require reviewed lockfile changes, clear package caches, and remove unauthorized packages from all affected environments.

rules.title: Least Privilege - Package Credential Scraping
rules.description: Local telemetry indicates package or script behavior reading environment variables, package tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, or AI API keys.
hunt_steps: Identify which process/package accessed secrets
Scope exposed credentials
Correlate with outbound connections and install timestamps
rules.remediation: Revoke and rotate exposed secrets, constrain package install privileges, isolate build/install environments, and move secrets out of package execution contexts.

rules.title: Configuration Settings - Boot and Firmware Tamper
rules.description: Local telemetry indicates bootkit, EFI variable, secure boot, or boot component tampering that can preserve malware below the OS.
rules.check_value: bootkit|efi variable|uefi|secure boot disabled|boot component modified|boot-start driver|bootloader modified|bcdedit
hunt_steps: Capture boot configuration and secure boot state
Review recent firmware/bootloader changes
Validate boot components from trusted media
rules.remediation: Preserve evidence, boot from trusted media, restore secure boot and trusted boot components, and re-image if firmware or boot compromise is confirmed.
